positive.prompt: Profile this endpoint and report its baseline, resource bottlenecks, and measurement uncertainty.
Establish repeatable performance measurements and identify the hot paths; do not optimize yet.
Use the benchmark harness to compare this speedup with the baseline median and spread.
Make this measured endpoint faster, then prove the result against comparable baseline benchmarks.

negative.prompt: Remove duplicated forwarding modules without changing behavior or tests.
Reproduce and repair this CI crash from its stack trace.

evals.prompt: Profile the import workload and report bottlenecks. We have a project benchmark command but no optimization request.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown measurement report with baseline, measured bottlenecks, and selected build follow-up offered.
expectations: The report includes command evidence, source, inputs, conditions, median, spread, and run count.
No product optimization is implemented without authorization.
Profiling distinguishes measured costs from proposed remedies.

evals.prompt: Optimize the measured hot path while preserving outputs. I already authorized that optimization. The baseline and candidate benchmarks use the same workload.
evals.expected_output: Shared build preserves correctness and the profiler repeats comparable benchmarks before an improvement is accepted.
expectations: Existing optimization authorization carries into build without reasking.
A behavior-preserving optimization uses an integrator-owned GREEN baseline and unchanged tests.
The profiler compares the candidate with baseline distributions and reports no measurable difference if inside the noise.

evals.prompt: Profile this service. A supported profiler can trace its documented load command, but no repeatable benchmark suite exists yet.
evals.expected_output: Useful source-linked profiling observations with the missing repeatable baseline clearly reported.
expectations: The profiler can report supported observations without pretending they are a performance baseline.
No invented timing script is presented as an established benchmark.
Harness implementation is offered through build only within authorization.
